items.headline: Minnesota hosts Akron in Week 3
items.description: Akron (1-1) at Minnesota (1-1), Sept. 19 at 12 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Taylor, Bothwell lead MS State to win vs. Minnesota
items.description: Kamario Taylor shines in the pocket with 227 passing yards and three touchdowns as Fluff Bothwell gets 113 rushing yards and two TDs in the Bulldogs' 38-13 victory over the Golden Gophers.

items.headline: Mississippi State races past Minnesota 38-13 with another clinic by rising star QB Kamario Taylor
items.description: — Kamario Taylor passed for 227 yards and three first-half touchdowns to lead Mississippi State in a 38-13 takedown of Minnesota on Saturday in the first-ever football game between the two schools.

items.headline: Bill Connelly's Week 2 preview: Big Ten-SEC challenge, early conference tests
items.description: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.

items.headline: Heisman of the week: Miami's Malachi Toney gets jump on the field
items.description: We'll hand out some hardware every week -- and our first winner is the Hurricanes' dynamic receiver.

items.headline: Mississippi State squares off against Minnesota in Week 2
items.description: Mississippi State (1-0) at Minnesota (1-0), Sept. 12 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.
